description: Start a deterministic CopyPass review for caller-provided AI-generated copy. Returns evidence-backed copy findings, scope boundaries, disclaimer text, a structured copypass_receipt_v1 proof envelope, and optional CopyRoom exact-copy receipt.

audience.description: Optional intended audience for the copy.

channel.description: Optional surface label such as homepage_hero, pricing_section, or onboarding_email.

copy_text.description: The AI-generated copy to review. Optional when copyroom_source_packet is provided; exact-copy verification compares this text byte-for-byte against the packet.

copyroom_output_pointer.description: Pointer to the intended output artifact for the CopyRoom receipt.

copyroom_required.description: Set true when exact fidelity matters. Missing copyroom_source_packet returns COPYROOM_MISSING instead of a run with a null receipt.

copyroom_source_packet.description: Exact source packet for CopyRoom fidelity work. Use this instead of retyping source text when code, prompts, labels, tables, documents, or user-provided text must stay exact.

encoding.description: CopyRoom v1 encoding. Defaults to utf8.

newline_policy.description: CopyRoom v1 newline policy. Defaults to preserve.

text.description: Exact source text to copy or verify.

goal.description: Optional goal for the copy, such as clarity, conversion, or trust.

profile.description: Review depth label for this scoped run. Defaults to smoke.

name: copypass_run
